question: just moved to munich last week with the family, do we really have to do this registration thing and how fast?
reference_answer: Yes. Everyone who moves into a flat in Germany must register (Anmeldung) with the registration office within two weeks of moving in (§ 17 (1) BMG). In Munich the family can register together at a Bürgerbüro; you need your passports, the landlord's confirmation (Wohnungsgeberbestätigung) and marriage/birth certificates.
notes: Vague term 'registration thing' -> Anmeldung. Tests EN->DE rewriting.

question: We move into our new flat in Munich on 1 December 2026. What's the last day I can do the Anmeldung?
reference_answer: You must register within two weeks of moving in (§ 17 (1) BMG), so the deadline is 15 December 2026. If no Bürgerbüro appointment is available in time, book the earliest slot and keep proof of the booking.
notes: Date arithmetic must come from the deadline tool, not the LLM.

question: my landlord won't give me that confirmation paper for the registration, can I still register without it?
reference_answer: The landlord (Wohnungsgeber) is legally obliged to confirm your move-in in writing or electronically within two weeks (§ 19 (1) BMG); refusing is an administrative offence. Tell the Bürgerbüro that the landlord refuses; the registration office can then pursue the landlord.
notes: 'confirmation paper' -> Wohnungsgeberbestätigung (§ 19 BMG). Needs BM25 on the German term.

question: Welche Unterlagen brauche ich für die Anmeldung mit Frau und zwei Kindern in München?
reference_answer: Für die Familienanmeldung in München brauchen Sie die Pässe bzw. Ausweise aller Familienmitglieder, die Wohnungsgeberbestätigung des Vermieters, das ausgefüllte Anmeldeformular sowie Heirats- und Geburtsurkunden (bei ausländischen Urkunden ggf. mit Übersetzung).
notes: German question; checklist tool grounded in the family Anmeldung page.

question: whats the minimum salary for the blue card in 2026? my offer is 48k as a software developer
reference_answer: In 2026 the standard Blue Card threshold is €50,700 gross per year. For shortage occupations (including IT specialists) and recent graduates a lower threshold of €45,934.20 applies, with approval of the Federal Employment Agency (§ 18g (1) AufenthG). A €48,000 offer as a software developer is above the lower threshold, so a Blue Card is possible under the shortage-occupation rule.
notes: Thresholds per docs/tools.md (50% / 45.3% of the pension contribution ceiling, verified against § 18g on gesetze-im-internet.de).

question: how long until I can get permanent residence with the blue card? my german is about B1
reference_answer: Blue Card holders get a settlement permit (Niederlassungserlaubnis) after 27 months of Blue Card employment with basic German (A1), or after 21 months with sufficient German (B1) (§ 18c (2) AufenthG). With B1 you can apply after 21 months; other requirements such as pension contributions apply.
notes: 'permanent residence' -> Niederlassungserlaubnis. 27/21 months verified in § 18c (2) AufenthG.

question: Meine Blaue Karte läuft im März ab. Wann muss ich die Verlängerung bei der Ausländerbehörde beantragen?
reference_answer: Die Verlängerung muss vor Ablauf der Blauen Karte beantragt werden. Wird der Antrag rechtzeitig gestellt, gilt der bisherige Aufenthaltstitel bis zur Entscheidung als fortbestehend (Fiktionswirkung, § 81 Abs. 4 AufenthG). Da die Bearbeitung in München lange dauern kann, sollten Sie den Antrag möglichst früh stellen.

question: do I have to pay that TV tax thing (rundfunk) even if I don't own a TV?
reference_answer: Yes. The broadcasting fee (Rundfunkbeitrag) is charged per household (per flat), regardless of whether you own a TV or radio. It is €18.36 per month, and one payment covers everyone living in the flat.

question: can I switch jobs in my first year on the blue card or do I need permission?
reference_answer: You do not need a new permit to change employers, but during the first 12 months of employment the Ausländerbehörde can suspend and refuse the job change if the new job does not meet the Blue Card conditions (§ 18g (4) AufenthG). Inform the Ausländerbehörde before switching; the new job must still meet the salary threshold and match your qualification.
notes: § 18g (4) AufenthG verified on gesetze-im-internet.de (authority may suspend/refuse in the first 12 months).

question: I'm leaving Germany for good next month. do I need to unregister somewhere?
reference_answer: Yes. If you move out and do not take up a new home in Germany, you must deregister (Abmeldung) within two weeks after moving out (§ 17 (2) BMG); it can be done up to one week before you leave.

question: I'm here on a student visa, do I also need to register my address or is that only for people who work?
reference_answer: Yes. The registration duty applies to everyone who moves into a flat, including students: register within two weeks of moving in (§ 17 (1) BMG). You will also need the registration certificate (Meldebescheinigung) for your residence permit.

question: I've rented my flat in Munich for 6 years. How much notice does my landlord have to give me?
reference_answer: Six months: the landlord's notice period extends from 3 to 6 months after 5 years of tenancy (§ 573c (1) BGB). The landlord also needs a legitimate interest (§ 573 BGB).
notes: Example from docs/evaluation-plan.md. Tests § lookup via BM25 + the tool.

question: found a new place, how much notice do I need to give my landlord if I want to move out?
reference_answer: As a tenant with an open-ended contract your notice period is 3 months, regardless of how long you have lived there. The notice must reach the landlord by the 3rd working day of a month to count for that month (§ 573c (1) BGB), and it must be a signed letter, not an email (§ 568 BGB).

question: Wie hoch darf die Kaution maximal sein und muss ich alles auf einmal zahlen?
reference_answer: Die Kaution darf höchstens drei Monatsmieten ohne Betriebskosten (Nettokaltmiete) betragen. Sie dürfen sie in drei gleichen monatlichen Teilzahlungen leisten; die erste ist zu Beginn des Mietverhältnisses fällig (§ 551 BGB).

question: landlord wants to raise my rent by 20% here in munich, is that even allowed??
reference_answer: No. In Munich the rent may rise by at most 15% within three years (capping limit / Kappungsgrenze, § 558 (3) BGB with the Bavarian Mieterschutzverordnung valid until 2029-12-31), and never above the local comparative rent from the Mietspiegel. The rent must also have been unchanged for 15 months, and you have until the end of the second month after receiving the request to consent (§ 558b BGB).

question: is there some kind of rent cap for new contracts in munich? I think my new rent is way too high
reference_answer: Yes, the rent brake (Mietpreisbremse) applies in Munich until 2029-12-31: at the start of a tenancy the rent may not exceed the local comparative rent by more than 10% (§ 556d BGB). Exceptions include new buildings first let after 1 October 2014, comprehensive modernisation and a higher previous rent. To reclaim excess rent you must complain to the landlord in text form (§ 556g BGB).

question: only got my nebenkosten bill for 2024 now in december 2026 and they want 600 euro extra. do I still have to pay?
reference_answer: Probably not. The landlord must send the service-charge statement (Betriebskostenabrechnung) within 12 months after the end of the accounting period; after that he can no longer demand back-payments unless he is not responsible for the delay (§ 556 (3) BGB). For calendar year 2024 the deadline was 31 December 2025.

question: Mein Vermieter hat mir nach 10 Jahren wegen Eigenbedarf gekündigt. Welche Kündigungsfrist gilt für mich?
reference_answer: Nach mehr als acht Jahren Mietdauer beträgt die Kündigungsfrist des Vermieters neun Monate (§ 573c Abs. 1 BGB). Eigenbedarf ist ein berechtigtes Interesse (§ 573 Abs. 2 Nr. 2 BGB); Sie können bei unzumutbarer Härte widersprechen (§ 574 BGB).

question: heating has been broken for 3 weeks in january and the landlord does nothing. can I pay less rent?
reference_answer: Yes. If a defect significantly impairs the use of the flat, the rent is reduced automatically by law for the period of the defect (Mietminderung, § 536 BGB). You must notify the landlord of the defect without delay (§ 536c BGB). The appropriate reduction depends on the case, so it is safer to pay under reservation and get advice, e.g. from a tenants' association (Mieterverein).

question: can I sublet a room in my flat to a friend while I'm abroad for 6 months on a project?
reference_answer: You need your landlord's permission. If a legitimate interest arises after you signed the lease (e.g. a temporary stay abroad), you can demand permission to let part of the flat to a third party, unless the person is unacceptable or the flat would be overcrowded (§ 553 (1) BGB). Subletting without permission can justify termination.

question: what is this mietspiegel thing and how do I check if my rent is normal for munich?
reference_answer: The Mietspiegel is the city's official table of local comparative rents (ortsübliche Vergleichsmiete). Munich publishes a qualified Mietspiegel (2025) with an online calculator where you enter location, size, year of construction and features to see the typical rent range for your flat.

question: my contract has a staffelmiete, rent goes up every year. can the landlord also do the normal rent increase on top of that?
reference_answer: No. While a graduated rent (Staffelmiete) applies, the landlord cannot additionally raise the rent to the local comparative rent (§ 558) or for modernisation (§ 559); each step must stay unchanged for at least one year (§ 557a BGB).

question: how much is the kinder money per kid now?
reference_answer: Child benefit (Kindergeld) is €259 per child per month in 2026 (§ 66 (1) EStG).

question: we have 2 kids, how much kindergeld do we get per month in total?
reference_answer: €518 per month: €259 for each of your two children (§ 66 (1) EStG). As Blue Card holders you are eligible (§ 62 (2) EStG).
notes: Sum must come from the tool.

question: can I even get kindergeld as a non-EU guy on a blue card?
reference_answer: Yes. Non-EU citizens living in Germany are entitled to Kindergeld if they hold a residence title that allows employment; the EU Blue Card qualifies (§ 62 (2) EStG). Apply at the Familienkasse.

question: Wir haben vergessen, Kindergeld zu beantragen. Unser Baby ist im Januar 2026 geboren. Bekommen wir das Geld rückwirkend?
reference_answer: Nur teilweise: Kindergeld wird rückwirkend nur für die letzten sechs Monate vor Beginn des Monats gezahlt, in dem der Antrag bei der Familienkasse eingeht (§ 70 Abs. 1 EStG). Stellen Sie den Antrag daher sofort.
notes: German question; 6-month retroactivity is in § 70 (1) EStG (not § 66).

question: how much elterngeld would I get roughly? I make about 3000 net a month, baby due in march 2027
reference_answer: Basic parental allowance (Basiselterngeld) replaces 65% of net income above €1,240, which for €3,000 would be about €1,950, but it is capped at €1,800 per month, so you would get about €1,800 (§ 2 BEEG; range €300–1,800). This is an estimate; your Elterngeldstelle calculates the exact amount.

question: my wife and I together earn about 190k taxable. can we still get elterngeld for the baby next year?
reference_answer: No. For births from 1 April 2025 there is no Elterngeld if the parents' combined taxable income in the year before the birth exceeds €175,000 (§ 1 (8) BEEG). With about €190,000 you are above the cap.

question: how many months of elterngeld can we get and can we both take it at the same time?
reference_answer: Together you can get up to 14 months of Basiselterngeld: 12 months plus 2 partner months if both parents take part (§ 4 BEEG). For births from April 2024 parents can receive Basiselterngeld at the same time for at most one month, within the first 12 months of the child's life (exceptions e.g. for multiple births or premature babies).
notes: § 4 BEEG; parallel-receipt limit since the 2024 reform.

question: how do I even find a kita spot for my 1 year old in munich, is there some online system?
reference_answer: Yes. In Munich you register for municipal and many other daycare places (Krippe/Kita) online through the city's kitafinder+ portal. Register as early as possible and list several preferred facilities; children have a legal right to a daycare place from age one.

question: Bis wann muss ich Elterngeld beantragen? Unser Kind kam am 10. Oktober 2026 zur Welt.
reference_answer: Es gibt keine feste Antragsfrist, aber Elterngeld wird rückwirkend nur für die letzten drei Lebensmonate vor dem Lebensmonat gezahlt, in dem der Antrag eingeht (§ 7 Abs. 1 BEEG). Damit Sie ab Geburt nichts verlieren, sollte der Antrag spätestens im vierten Lebensmonat (also bis 9. Februar 2027) eingehen; besser früher.
notes: German question; § 7 (1) BEEG verified (3 Lebensmonate retroactively). EU-citizen profile.

question: moving to munich in january with my wife and 2 kids on a blue card. what do we need to sort out first?
reference_answer: 1) Register the whole family at a Bürgerbüro within two weeks of moving in (Anmeldung, § 17 BMG). 2) Collect your residence permits / Blue Card at the Ausländerbehörde if not yet issued. 3) Apply for Kindergeld (€259 per child) at the Familienkasse. 4) Register your children for daycare via kitafinder+ as early as possible.
notes: Decomposition into registration, child benefit, daycare.

question: Wir ziehen mit unserem Baby nach München. Was müssen wir bei Anmeldung, Kindergeld und Elterngeld beachten?
reference_answer: Anmeldung: innerhalb von zwei Wochen nach dem Einzug (§ 17 BMG), für die Familie gemeinsam. Kindergeld: 259 € pro Monat, bei der Familienkasse beantragen, rückwirkend nur 6 Monate. Elterngeld: bei der Elterngeldstelle beantragen, rückwirkend nur 3 Lebensmonate; 300–1.800 € Basiselterngeld.

question: my wife wants to join me here on my blue card. can she work, and do we need a certain size of flat for the visa?
reference_answer: Spouses of Blue Card holders can join without proving German language skills (§ 30 AufenthG) and may work in Germany without restriction. For family reunification you must have sufficient living space and secure income (§ 29 (1) AufenthG); the Ausländerbehörde checks the flat size against local standards.

question: I'm a freelancer moving from Berlin to Munich next month. need to quit my Berlin flat and register in Munich, what are the deadlines for both?
reference_answer: Your notice to the Berlin landlord is 3 months, arriving by the 3rd working day of a month (§ 573c (1) BGB), as a signed letter (§ 568 BGB). In Munich you must register within two weeks of moving in (§ 17 (1) BMG); moving within Germany does not require a separate deregistration in Berlin.

question: my asylum application was rejected yesterday. how do I appeal and what should I write?
reference_answer: I can't give advice on asylum cases. Appeal deadlines are very short, so contact a lawyer for migration law or a free refugee/migration counselling service (e.g. Migrationsberatung, Refugee Law Clinic) immediately.
notes: Sensitive: asylum procedure -> redirect, no substantive advice.

question: can you just fill out my tax return for me? I made 85k, what numbers do I put in Anlage N?
reference_answer: I can't prepare your tax return. Please use ELSTER or a tax adviser (Steuerberater) or an income-tax assistance association (Lohnsteuerhilfeverein). I can help with registration, tenancy and family benefits.
notes: Out of scope: individual tax filing.

question: got caught on the U-Bahn without a ticket and now I got a letter from the police. will this kill my blue card?
reference_answer: Criminal proceedings and their effect on your residence status are outside what I can advise on. Please contact a criminal-law or migration-law lawyer before responding to the police letter.

question: Mein Vermieter hat Räumungsklage gegen uns eingereicht. Was soll ich dem Gericht schreiben?
reference_answer: Bei einer Räumungsklage laufen kurze gerichtliche Fristen. Ich kann Ihnen dazu keine Rechtsberatung geben. Wenden Sie sich bitte sofort an einen Mieterverein oder eine Anwältin bzw. einen Anwalt für Mietrecht.
notes: German; sensitive: active eviction lawsuit -> Mieterverein/lawyer.

question: my kid has a fever of 39.5 since this morning, which medicine should I give him?
reference_answer: I can't give medical advice. Please call your paediatrician, the medical on-call service 116117, or 112 in an emergency.
